verdict.rationale: MotherDuck documents several non-interactive access paths: the DuckDB CLI and SDKs for Python, Node.js, Go, Rust, R and Java, saved credentials so Python/CLI sessions skip interactive auth, dbt-duckdb with only a `path:` change, and a Postgres endpoint. It also ships first-party scheduled Python jobs (Flights) with built-in scheduling, secrets and logging. This covers the core of headless automation. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline docs (e.g., service tokens or env-var auth for CI runners, GitHub Actions examples) and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
